title: Deep merge
task: Implement deep_merge(base, override) in merge.py: return a new dict in which the keys of override replace those of base, except that when both values are dicts they are merged recursively. Neither input may be modified. Add tests.
follow_up: Requirement change: when both values are lists, the result is base's list followed by override's; and an override value of None deletes the key from the result. The inputs are still never modified. Add tests.
